finding.description: Original regex accepted repository . or .. while only checking trailing file path segments. Dot-segment normalization could make the nominal 40-hex segment a repository and a file-path segment the actual ref; commit-locator or single-commit provenance assertion was not enforced.
finding.resolution: Parse owner/repository/commit/path separately; explicitly reject . and .. repository, retain exact commit/hash and safe file-path checks. Tests cover both repository dot forms and valid namespace boundaries.
